title: SparkQuant-Lab fidelity run result
description: One completed fidelity comparison run (quantized candidate vs BF16 reference) produced by the qbench harness.

created_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the run.

git_rev.description: Git revision of the SparkQuant-Lab repo at run time.

qbench_rev.description: exllamav3 revision whose qbench.py was used, unchanged.

rows_used.description: IDs of the fidelity rows included in this run.

kld_median.description: Median per-token KLD, candidate vs reference.

kld_p90.description: 90th percentile per-token KLD, candidate vs reference.

kld_high_confidence.description: Mean KLD over the highest reference-confidence bucket.

excess_kld_over_noise_floor.description: Candidate KLD minus the BF16 self-noise floor KLD (null when noise floor disabled).

ppl_delta.description: Ratio of candidate ppl to reference ppl.

model_bytes.description: Total stored model bytes (layer + head), derived from qbench vram_gb * 2^30.

raw_output_path.description: Path to the raw qbench results JSON this record summarizes.
